purpose: Offline scalar evidence for Mini Gibson tool-calling development diagnostics
bundle_operation: Offline sanitization and recount only; no new inference or training

prior_development_cohort_reference.caveat: Previously reviewed development cohort, referenced by original source hashes. Its scalar rows are not duplicated in this bundle or recounted by this verifier.

interpretation.v8_comparison: The next development cohort barely improved: base 3/24, adapter 4/24. Compare within this batch only.
interpretation.selected_1024_diagnostic: Selected 21 previously malformed adapter tasks: 8 passed, 4 still malformed at the output limit. One test-file modification was flagged and failed.
interpretation.residual_1536_diagnostic: Selected remaining four malformed adapter tasks: 2 passed, 2 still malformed at the output limit. Both passes recovered after a tool error.
interpretation.next_experiment: Prepare shorter valid tool calls, inspect source before replacements, recover from failed calls, and retain tests and change boundaries.

caveats: v7 and v8 are different development cohorts with different harness revisions. Do not aggregate them as one same-harness experiment.
Token-limit diagnostics are selected adapter-only retries. No matched base retry arm was run in these files. Do not pool these diagnostic passes into the original comparison.
At-limit malformed output supports truncation as a failure mode; it does not establish that output length caused every failure.
execution_errors counts tool observations beginning ERROR. It does not count every nonzero shell-command exit.
Pass is based on deterministic test exit and changed-file allowlist. A model completion claim or a hosted judge does not determine pass.
Original source SHA256 values identify upstream receipts. They are provenance references, not signatures or an independently downloadable source archive.
Sanitized artifact SHA256 values and recounts can be independently verified with the included script.

observability.hosted_langfuse_status: No connected hosted session or export receipt evidenced in the inspected experiment records
observability.authority: Local deterministic test results and changed-file boundaries; hosted observability and judge exports are optional and do not determine pass

privacy.included: Task IDs, scalar outcomes and counts, model identity and revision, cryptographic provenance hashes
